outgoing.name: Cretaceous
outgoing.excerpt: Gallimimus (gal-ih-MY-mus) , meaning 'fowl mimic', was an ornithomimosaur from the late Cretaceous Period ( Maastrichtian stage) Nemegt Formation of Mongolia.

outgoing.name: Fossil
outgoing.excerpt: The fossil remains of this dinosaur were discovered in the early 1970s in the Gobi Desert of Mongolia.
